@deskPairDomainChecking.description: Pairing window, desktop and phone: a muted line under the four words while the wallet checks the domain the new contact claims. If the domain proves the contact's key, the window turns Verified. {domain} is the domain, e.g. shop.example.

deskPairDomainVerifiedBody: {domain} confirms this is {name}’s wallet. No words to compare.

@deskPairDomainVerifiedBody.description: Pairing window: the line under the Verified title when the contact's domain proved its wallet, so the four words were not needed.

@deskPairVerifiedByDomain.description: Contact page, desktop and phone, and the invoice review: how a Verified contact was verified when its domain proved its key and the four words were not compared. {domain} is the domain, e.g. shop.example.
